content: # LLMs.txt This template generates AI-facing text exports from the docs corpus. ## Generated Files - `/llms.txt` - `/llms-full.txt` ## Why They Exist These files give AI tools and internal agents a clean text entry point without requiring them to crawl the full UI. ## How They Are Generated `npm run build` runs `scripts/generate-llms.mjs` automatically. `npm run generate:llms` runs the same script without a full build when you only need fresh AI exports. ## When To Regenerate Regenerate after: - changing Markdown content - renaming or restructuring docs sections - updating docs metadata that should appear in exported summaries ## Helpful Links Download llms.txt Download llms-full.txt Copy llms.txt URL
